jobs.title: Construction Management - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We are a building a leading AI product in the construction industry focusing on an underserved stakeholder: The Owner. Our customers are large owners and operators of buildings and facilities responsible for the largest construction projects across New York City and the US. This is an opportunity to be part of a nimble team where every individual is an expert in their area, grows both in skill and career progression at a rapid pace. We iterate quickly and create a product that transforms how our customers work through AI.

This is the place for you if you’ve worked in a role at the intersection of AI, automation of workflows, data analytics, construction technology, construction management and project controls — and you’re looking for the next leap in your career.

We’re a growing company backed by Primary Ventures, LDV Capital, Pear VC, and other top investors. You will work directly with the CEO and our customers—large organizations that own and operate hospitals, universities, public infrastructure and data centers. You’ll have the opportunity to shape our product strategy by exploring various data sources, datasets, running exploratory AI models, automating workflows, training agents and providing analytics that support customer decisions. This is a unique chance to join early and shape your career with Gryps.

Must Haves

Have a Master’s degree (or higher) in Civil Engineering/Construction Management or a quantitative field (e.g., engineering, mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science or similar) with graduate research focused on AI/machine learning applications in construction or closely related field.
2+ years of work experience involving quantitative data analysis and complex problem-solving in construction.
Experience building AI agents to automate workflows (preference if you built workflows in construction).
Proficiency in SQL and Python, along with experience using AWS Quicksight, Power BI, Tableau, Jupyter Notebook, or other data visualization and exploration tools.
Have 3+ years of construction industry experience.
Possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Are curious, a great listener, and enjoy working with customers to find data-driven ways to support decision-making.

You would love your job if you:

Are customer-obsessed and love helping people apply AI in their workflows
Are looking to join a small team and grow your career
Great at multi-tasking and can operate in high stakes environments
Get excited by creating new processes, working with data, and innovating data applications
Are intrigued by how AI and RPA are changing the construction industry
Love collaborating across teams to solve problems
Want to grow your career in product roles, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or related fields
Are passionate about disrupting the construction industry with technology
Are a fast learner and have a deep understanding of technology systems in the construction industry
Love increasing efficiency through technology

What you'll be doing:

Understanding customer processes, data strategy, data sources and systems, policies and procedures, decision-making and identifying opportunities to increase efficiency through automation
Analyzing data structures from construction systems or public data sources and enhancing the Gryps knowledge graph
Setting up automated workflows, optimizing AI Agents, creating dashboards, reconfiguring processes, or leading whiteboard sessions to map out customer use cases
Consulting with customers on how to leverage their data and automate their processes via the Gryps platform
Documenting data workflows, data policies, structures, standards, and procedures for the Gryps implementation
Developing and running advanced descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics using Jupyter Notebook and Python
Gathering feedback on current Gryps use cases and identifying new opportunities
Leading Gryps training sessions for customer users

We recognize you as an early joiner by:

Competitive compensation
Flexible paid time off
Medical, dental, and vision benefits
Flexible career path
Direct influence on our product and company roadmap

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst who can turn complex business data into clear insights, reliable reporting, and practical recommendations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys investigating business questions, developing useful dashboards, and helping teams understand what drives performance.

You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to define meaningful metrics, improve reporting accuracy, and identify opportunities across operations, customer experience, and business performance. The role combines hands-on analysis with direct stakeholder collaboration, giving you ownership of analytical projects from the initial question through to recommendations and follow-up measurement.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business questions into analytical plans, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build and maintain dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform.
Analyze trends, investigate performance changes, and explain the factors behind key results.
Define and document KPIs, reporting logic, and metric calculations to support consistent decision-making.
Validate datasets, investigate discrepancies, and collaborate with data teams to resolve quality issues.
Automate recurring reports and reduce manual work while maintaining accuracy.
Present findings in concise reports and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Partner with stakeholders to prioritize requests and establish realistic delivery timelines.
Measure the results of business initiatives and recommend next steps based on the evidence.

Required Qualifications

4–8 years of relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related analytical role.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, and aggregations.
Hands-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; expertise in either platform is sufficient.
Strong Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
Experience working with relational databases and combining information from multiple datasets.
Practical understanding of descriptive statistics, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Ability to distinguish between correlation and causation and communicate limitations in the data.
Experience gathering stakeholder requirements and independently delivering analytical projects.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain findings and their business implications.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.
Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Azure.
Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT workflows, and version control.
Experience with forecasting, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, or A/B testing.
Experience improving reporting processes or supporting self-service analytics.

Preferred qualifications are helpful, but candidates do not need experience with every listed tool.

What Success Looks Like

Stakeholders have access to accurate, understandable, and timely reporting.
Key metrics use consistent definitions and documented calculations.
Analysis explains the reasons behind performance changes and supports actionable decisions.
Recurring reporting requires less manual effort.
Findings are communicated clearly, including assumptions and limitations.

How to Apply

Submit your resume highlighting relevant analytical projects, the tools you used, and the business outcomes you supported. A portfolio is welcome but optional; please exclude confidential employer or client information.

jobs.description:
Soccer Shots is the #1 Children's Soccer program in the country.
Why? Aside from the incredible curriculum, leadership, and passion, we only hire the best instructors to work with our children. It's imperative that you not only enjoy working with children, but you also have outstanding soccer experience and are incredibly passionate about spreading the love of the sport. We want our Soccer Shots sessions to be the BEST 30-45 minutes of each child's week-as we strive to develop basic soccer skills, teamwork and healthy lifestyles in each of our children.

Soccer Shots Kalamazoo is searching for a Full-Time Assistant Program Coordinator. As the Assistant Program Coordinator, you will coach 20-25 hours per week during the season, and also assist the Program Director in scheduling, marketing, and customer service. We operate in daycares, preschools, and parks all over Kalamazoo County. We provide training, apparel, equipment, and all curriculum materials. We offer rewarding work in a great environment with the opportunity to inspire the youngest soccer players in our community. A Benefits package and Bonuses may be available.

The Ideal Instructor MUST Meet The Following Criteria

Safety-conscious, your #1 priority is the safety of children under your care.
Caring, you engage with each child through specific and positive affirmation.
Organized, you plan ahead and are systematic in routine, conducting each session according to the lesson plan and working with children to maintain appropriate order for the age group.
Responsible, you are committed to doing what is expected as the coach and "face" of Soccer Shots.
Energetic, you bring Soccer Shots to life by creating a fun and exciting atmosphere that leads a child to smile and participate.
Motivated, you are a team-player and present your best self in all aspects of the role.
You must hold a valid Driver's License and have reliable transportation.
A successful candidate must pass a Child Abuse History Clearance and Background Check.

jobs.description:

About Our Client:

The organization operates within the healthcare sector, focusing on improving care delivery and operational performance. It serves a large patient population through numerous practices nationwide, addressing challenges in healthcare by leveraging data and technology to enhance financial and operational outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

The BUSINESS AND DATA ANALYST role is centered on developing and maintaining data visualization tools and reports to support decision-making in financial and operational areas. This position impacts the organization by providing insights through data interpretation, automating workflows, and collaborating with operational leaders to improve healthcare delivery and business processes.

Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Power Platform solutions for stakeholder self-service.
Design metrics and reports on financial and operational performance of new products and services.
Consult with stakeholders to define data requirements and business rules.
Create clear reports and dashboards for leadership on performance metrics.
Analyze data to identify trends and root causes, suggesting improvements.
Ensure high standards of data quality and regulatory compliance.
Manage a library of operational and financial reports and dashboards.
Handle standard and ad hoc data requests using internal and external sources.
Provide financial tracking support, including invoice review.
Deliver metrics and reports to management and clients to guide business decisions.
Partner with operational leaders to scope problems and deliver solutions.
Build automation and workflow solutions to reduce manual effort.
Facilitate information sharing across business units.
Support performance improvement efforts with operational leaders.
Oversee activities that sustain financial health of practices and programs.
Collaborate on company-wide initiatives and reporting solutions.
Assist in developing site reports, operational assessments, and proposals.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Health Administration, Public Health, Technology, or related field.
1-3 years of experience in data analysis and/or healthcare-focused programs.
Preferred proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint).
Preferred experience with AI tools for analysis and workflow efficiency.
Experience with Tableau and other BI tools preferred.
Ability to apply systems thinking to identify root causes and design solutions.
Capability to independently design and deliver technology solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Basic medical terminology knowledge.
Experience in program development and project management concepts.
Ability to manage detailed work under deadlines and work collaboratively.
Commitment to healthcare improvement and adaptability to changing priorities.
Knowledge of healthcare regulations and data quality standards.

jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
This organization operates in the FinTech sector, addressing economic inclusion and financial resilience. It focuses on providing accessible tools to help individuals build credit and savings, targeting over 100 million Americans with no or low credit. The organization emphasizes collaboration to ensure its products reach those who can benefit most.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Staff Data Analyst role within the Product and Customer Analytics team is focused on driving sustainable growth across the customer lifecycle. This position involves owning key metrics and analytical systems related to credit products and customer engagement. The role requires applying deep analytical skills to influence business decisions and collaborating across teams to enhance data-driven strategies.

• Lead analytical projects to identify drivers of customer and product behavior beyond correlations.
• Collaborate with Data and Analytics Engineering on data model development.
• Partner with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to define measurement strategies and influence the business roadmap.
• Develop and manage AI-driven tools and semantic workflows to optimize analytics processes.
• Maintain business intelligence dashboards and reporting on lifecycle marketing KPIs and campaign performance.
• Apply advanced analytical techniques including statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and causal inference.
• Communicate insights effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
• Stay informed on trends in financial products, AI, analytics engineering, and business intelligence.

4. Requirements:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or related fields.
• Over 8 years of experience in data analytics supporting product teams, preferably in fintech or related consumer industries.

• Experience with BI tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
• Proficiency with analytics engineering ELT tools such as dbt, Databricks, Airflow, or Git.
